method: Direct complete 1-end character semantic inspection of 125 read-only pg_catalog function declarations and all SQL bodies from precise prior cursor, lexicographic name/identity_args/OID; 125 source declarations read in tool output before recording; compiled native implementations not exposed.
findings: Three complete SQL bit_length wrappers have appropriate length/byte-to-bit semantics, 122 internal routines expose declarations but not compiled code.
No app-specific executable dead code or safe deletion; zero BRIN indexes is not cause to remove PostgreSQL BRIN support.

The 3162 historical denominator includes 15 window functions; 3147 ordinary functions/procedures plus 15 window definitions. Aggregate prokind=a objects (157) require separate review and cannot be passed to pg_get_functiondef as ordinary functions.
Native PostgreSQL implementation source and console-only provider surfaces remain UNVERIFIED.

next_cursor.sort: proname COLLATE C, pg_get_function_identity_arguments COLLATE C, oid
